remote.dispatch_unsupported: dispatch-bound options are not available in server mode yet

remote.git_full_sha: delivery requires a full commit SHA

remote.git_commit_unavailable: published commit is unavailable from the common remote
remote.git_evidence_sha: Git evidence requires a full commit SHA
remote.git_unsafe_origin: Git origin is ambiguous or contains credentials; use a credential-free project remote

remote.wrap_up_author_required: wrap-up requires an author and reason
